name: Veronica de Piante
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $770 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Italian-made women's tailoring, coats, leather, silk dresses and knitwear at designer prices, sold through its Madison Avenue boutique, its site, Net-a-Porter and a few boutiques.
origin: Founded in 2022 by Veronica de Piante.

ownership.owner: VDP Fashion LLC (operating company per site terms; shareholders not published)

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 77 of 94 styles (168 feed records less 7 shoes = 161 listings, collapsed on the style name before ' in <cloth>, colour'); two snoods droppe

craft_evidence.makers: no — 'specialist artisans in Gallarate, Lombardy' (knits), 'in Prato, Tuscany', 'couture ateliers in Parma, Emilia-Romagna', 'leather artisans in Italy'; towns named, makers not
craft_evidence.madein: 100% (80 of 80 sampled pages say 'Made in Italy')
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every page says Made in Italy, and the knit, couture and leather pages name the town of the workshop (Gallarate, Prato, Parma), but no maker, mill or process is named. That is a 2. The case for 3: the making towns are named by category across the whole range.
